A '''fire whip''' was an exotic weapon. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] was known to use a fire whip during interrogation sessions, and employed it against [[Jessa Dajus]] sometime prior to the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol]]. Victims of the fire whip suffered thin, strip-like burns where the weapon had come into contact with their skin.
